MemberSignature.Value: .method public hidebysig instance class Android.App.Notification/Action/Builder SetAuthenticationRequired(bool authenticationRequired) cil managed

Docs.param: boolean
Docs.summary: Sets whether the OS should only send this action's on an unlocked device.
Docs.remarks:
Sets whether the OS should only send this action's on an unlocked device. If this is true and the device is locked when the action is invoked, the OS will show the keyguard and require successful authentication before invoking the intent. If this is false and the device is locked, the OS will decide whether authentication should be required.

Docs.remarks:
